answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 51409 Country: United Kingdom Title: Speaker giving a talk can see women Question: There were some prominent ulema in UK giving a talk. The men and women were separated but the man giving the talk could see both women and men and the women could see him. Is this permissible? Answer ID: 51409 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 497/497/M=04/1435) This way is not right as non-mahram men and women should observe purdah, it is unlawful for male speaker to look at non-mahram women and for women to see the non-mahram man without any Shariah necessity. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
